name: PET 2L v2 conditional vertical ascent

input_status.geometry: Existing v2 STL and assembly positions; bottle envelope is unmeasured.
input_status.printed_part_mass: CAD material volume times assumed 1.24 g/cm3, not print weight.
input_status.bottle_mass_kg: Provisional pet_bottle_2l catalog value, not measured.
input_status.nozzle_diameter_m: Provisional bottle_nozzle_9mm catalog value; fit is not verified.
input_status.retention_mass_kg: Illustrative allowance; retention is not designed or verified.
input_status.fill_fraction: Illustrative scenario assumption, not a measured loading.
input_status.gauge_pressure_pa: Illustrative simulation initial condition, not an approved operating pressure.
input_status.drag_coefficient: Assumed constant axial drag; no CFD or flight calibration.
input_status.environment_and_guide: Idealized still air, sea-level pressure, vertical axis and provisional 1 m guide.

scope: Ascent to apogee only. No recovery, structural, retention, or flight-stability qualification.
